frozen_model.formula: Beta(1,1)-smoothed previous observed resolved Up frequency per asset; no model selection or fitting after holdout begins
frozen_model.limits: Reconstructed frequency benchmark, not historical bot decisions, independent model approval, individual-event calibration or profit evidence. Repeated overlapping market regimes invalidate IID confidence interpretations.

limitations: Eight forward outcomes are a smoke study, not statistical validation or demonstrated alpha.
Historical bot forecasts and actual fills never existed in this dataset.
Reconstructed frequency benchmark is not an independently approved calibrated forecast.
Displayed terminal references and RTDS spot do not supply the complete authoritative Chainlink TWAP history.
Production valuation/oracle tooling must abstain where verified rules, calibration or settlement series are absent.

oracle_counterexamples.interpretation: Exchange candles rose; official winner was Down. Minute close is not exact TWAP. Diagnostic backfill, never OOS forecast input.
